pr.title: Scaffold dth-pc and seed it from the L1 entry
pr.body:
## Summary

Implements **Steps PC-4, PC-5, PC-6, PC-7, and PC-8** of [`litlfred/dth-pc#2`](https://github.com/litlfred/dth-pc/issues/2) (*Workplan: product catalogue handbook as an L2 DTH (`dth-pc`)*):

1. **PC-4 — Repository & Mount Wiring:**
   - Wired `dth-pc` from the `dth-hrh` / `dth-sc` template, mounting `who-iris` (`f98ec83a5d`, `fix/dth-pc-l1-9789240116191-eng` from `litlfred/who-iris#7`), `smart-base` (`49178a48d4`), `dpi-h-ra` (`litlfred/smart-ra@2c01ca0331`), and `dth-sc` (`f291f3642b`, `claude/dth-sc-scaffold` tip).

2. **PC-5 — Folio Seeding, Domain Glossary, Information Model, Step Tables, Figures & Best Practices:**
   - **Domain Glossary (`glossary/dth-pc.glossary.json`):** 16 SKOS terms (`Product Master Data`, `Generic Product`, `Trade Item`, `Regulated Trade Item`, `National Product Catalogue`, `Product Catalogue Management Tool`, `Product Classification`, `Packaging Hierarchy`, `Unit of Use`, `Master Data Governance Group`, `Data Owner`, `Data Custodian`, `Data Steward`, `Cataloguer`, `Catalogue User`, `Transactional Data`) with `exactMatch` / `closeMatch` / `broadMatch` / `related` links into `dth-sc` and `dpi-h-ra`.
   - **33 Structured `table` Blocks (`t-*`):**
     - **18 Step Tables across Chapters 1–5 (`t-ch01-step-1`..`t-ch05-step-3`):** Full `INPUTS | STEPS | RESOURCES | OUTPUTS` and `POTENTIAL RISKS | MITIGATION` tables extracted from `who-iris/library/9789240116191-eng`.
     - **Information Model & HL7 FHIR R5 Mapping Tables (Chapter 2):**
       - `t-ch02-fig-8-linkage` (`tbl:ch02-fig-8-linkage`): Product Classification → Generic Product (`1` → `0..*`) → Trade Item (`1` → `0..*`) → Regulated Trade Item linkage and code examples.
       - `t-ch02-fig-9-information-model` (`tbl:ch02-fig-9-information-model`): Complete Product Master Data attribute and cardinality dictionary across `Generic Product`, `Trade Item`, and `Regulated Trade Item`, mapped to HL7 FHIR R5 `MedicationKnowledge`, `InventoryItem`, `ClinicalUseDefinition`, `RegulatedAuthorization`, and `Organization` resources.
       - `t-ch02-fig-11-packaging-variations` (`tbl:ch02-fig-11-packaging-variations`) and `t-ch02-fig-12-fhir-packaging` (`tbl:ch02-fig-12-fhir-packaging`): Packaging Hierarchy variations and recursive `InventoryItem.association` / `InventoryItem.instance` FHIR R5 representation.
     - **Front-Matter, Introduction, Chapter 4/6/7/8 & Annex Tables:** `t-front-abbreviations`, `t-front-glossary`, `t-introduction-target-users`, `t-ch04-minimum-attributes` (local identifier → GTIN transition), `t-ch06-pcmt-access` (WHO-hosted PCMT access permissions), `t-ch07-global-good-flow` (bidirectional global good flow), `t-ch08-rwanda` / `t-ch08-zambia` / `t-ch08-nigeria` (`meta.sourceOnly: true`), and `t-annexes-annex-1` / `t-annexes-annex-2`.
   - **15 Vector `figure` Blocks (`f-*`, `fig:1`..`fig:15` + `folio/dth-pc/media/vfig-p*.png`):** Linked to `dpi-h-ra` ArchiMate `0.3.0-draft.1` views (`id-053fa0e33f6b5b0bb218195486c05160` *Product Master Data Information Model*, `id-02175c6feb9155618981ff120f954420` *National Product Catalogue*, `id-92267636cc42566ca5d2cff0e81be8c9` *DHSC Architecture Framework*, and `id-2d524cffba25509e82684f47d624cc42` *Health Supply Chain Partners and Processes*).

3. **PC-6 — Glossary & ArchiMate Link Validation (`bun run check:dth-glossary`):**
   - **624 glossary links** and **818 ArchiMate `0.3.0-draft.1` element/view links** + **18 figure-view mappings** across **126 folio blocks**, all verified against mounted `dth-pc`, `dth-sc`, and `dpi-h-ra`.

4. **PC-7 — 100% L1 Normative Marker Coverage (`bun run check:l1-coverage`):**
   - Added `scripts/folio/l1-coverage.ts`, `folio/dth-pc/l1-coverage.json`, and `docs/l1-coverage.md` using `folio-assistant-core/scripts/l1-coverage.ts`.
   - Accounts for **100%** of the **47 normative sentences** (**57 marker word hits** of `should` / `shall` / `must` / `recommend*` / `may be implemented`) across all **34 L1 sections**:
     - **34 sentences (72.34%)** captured in `folio/dth-pc/` narrative, step-table, figure, persona, and DMN blocks.
     - **13 sentences (27.66%)** excluded with owner sign-off (`litlfred`, `2026-10-31`): **7** `editorial` (PDF p. 3 WHO licence/disclaimer boilerplate), **5** `background-fact` (PDF pp. 8–9 front-matter Glossary definitions, also captured verbatim in `t-front-glossary`), and **1** `editorial` (PDF p. 55 bibliography citation #1).
     - **0 unaccounted sentences.**

5. **PC-8 — Roles, BPMN 2.0 Processes (+ Rendered SVGs) & DMN 1.3 Decision Tables:**
   - **19 Role Personas (`pers-pc-r-01`..`19`)** across Chapters 1, 2, 5, 6 and Annex 2.
   - **10 BPMN 2.0 Processes (`processes/PC-BP-01.bpmn`..`PC-BP-10.bpmn` + `bp-pc-bp-01`..`10`)** with deterministic rendered SVGs in `folio/dth-pc/media/bp-pc-bp-01.svg`..`bp-pc-bp-10.svg` (and `PC-BP-01.svg`..`PC-BP-10.svg`), flagging unassigned lanes in `PC-BP-06`, `PC-BP-07`, and `PC-BP-08`.
   - **2 DMN 1.3 Decision Tables (`processes/decisions/PC-DT-01.dmn`, `PC-DT-02.dmn` + `dt-pc-dt-01`, `dt-pc-dt-02`)**.

## Verification

- `bun run kg:blocks` & `bun run check:kg-blocks` → `128 sibling(s) up to date` (0 dangling references)
- `bun run check:dth-glossary` → `0 errors` (16 glossary terms, 624 glossary links, 818 ArchiMate links, 18 figure-view mappings, 33 tables, 15 figures, 19 personas, 10 BPMN processes with SVGs, 2 DMN tables, 100% L1 coverage)
- `bun run check:l1-coverage` → `0 errors` (`47 normative sentences (57 marker hits) across 34 sections — 34 captured (72.34%), 13 excluded, 0 unaccounted (100% accounted-for)`)
- `bun run check:library-kg` → `0 errors`
- `bun run site:document` & `bun run site:glossary` → builds `en/dth-pc/index.html` (`128 block(s)`) and `18` glossary pages cleanly
